while (version 0.5.0c to be precise). Debian unstable also has a fixed package 
(0.5.0d-3), already. However, as is the nature of debian testing, it takes a 
while until the fixed package makes it to testing, and when exactly this will 
happen is unknown. You can take a look at 
http://packages.qa.debian.org/r/rkward.html to track the status of the 
package, but there is no way to speed up this process.

To use rkward now, you can:
- follow the instructions for Debian & derivatives on 
http://apps.sourceforge.net/mediawiki/rkward/index.php?title=Binaries_and_Build_Scripts 
or
- follow the generic instructions on building RKWard from source:
http://apps.sourceforge.net/mediawiki/rkward/index.php?title=Building_RKWard_From_Source

Let us know, if you need further help.

Regards
Thomas

By: tfry

Our scatterplot plugin simply does not have support for this, yet. Of course
it is still possible to do this, but you'll have to write a bit of R code yourself.
You can start out with the code generated by the scatterplot plugin (click on
code, or copy it from the Command Log after running). Put that into a script
file and insert something like

    lines(spline(Xvars[[i]], Yvars[[i]]))

below the call to "points". click Run->Run all, and that should be it.

See also
   help(spline)

Regards
Thomas

Hi,

this is to announce the first preview release of RKWard running on MS Windows. 
If you have that "other OS" available, please give this a try: 
http://rkward.sourceforge.net/temp/install_rkward_0.5.1-pre2.exe . I fully 
expect there are still a lot of issues, including potential problems with the 
installer, but I think we are ready for a first round of testing.

A number of significant changes have happened on the Linux/BSD platform as well 
(see http://sourceforge.net/apps/mediawiki/rkward/index.php?title=Feature_Plan 
for some of them), and if you would like to see them now, the usual source 
tarball is here: http://rkward.sourceforge.net/temp/rkward-0.5.1-pre2.tar.gz .

An official 0.5.1-release is not yet scheduled, and is probably still some time 
away. A release timeline will be announced whenever a release is nearing, and 
as usual we will allot time for testing, translating and packaging. Still, 
with the summer vacation-season coming up, translators may want to start 
updating translations for 0.5.1-pre2, just in case.

Regards
Thomas

messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I've prepared new preview release of the upcoming RKWard 0.5.1, and would like 
to ask you to do some testing:
http://rkward.sf.net/temp/rkward-0.5.1-pre3.tar.gz

A windows .exe will probably follow tomorrow. It will be linked on the 
download page: 
http://sourceforge.net/apps/mediawiki/rkward/index.php?title=Download_RKWard .

The release schedule is available in the wiki, this time, at 
http://sourceforge.net/apps/mediawiki/rkward/index.php?title=Release_Schedule 
.

As you can see the period for testing / translations is quite long, with the 
deadline at July, 20th for both. I will be away from E-Mail during much of 
that time, but I'll make sure to look at everything that you report.

The targetted date for the final release is July, 28th.

Regards
Thomas
